name: smwgraphics-mega-man-x3-august-prototypes-doppler-stage
title: Mega Man X3 (August Prototypes) - Doppler Stage 2
description:
The background seen in the August Prototypes of Mega Man X3, which, in my humble opinion, fits Doppler Stage 2 much better than the final version. It uses palette rotation to animate the water. You can change the ExAnimation to Palette Rotate Left if you want the water flowing to the opposite way.

A good fit for industrial or sewer levels, in general.
